# IT Help San Diego Inc.

> Expert Apple IT support in San Diego for homes and businesses. No monthly retainers!

## What we do (read this first)

Software, systems, networks, and data — nothing you can hold with a cracked case.
We fix what's *inside* the device: the OS, the Wi-Fi, the DNS, the email, the security, the data.
A shattered screen, a swollen battery, a dropped phone, a dead board — that is a body-shop job, not ours.
If it's made of glass and glue, we don't open it; if it's made of logic and config, that's all we do.
We are the people you call *after* the hardware shop hands it back working — or instead of them, when it was never broken.
